summary: Today’s tone is broadly risk-off for precious metals and mixed-to-bearish for FX volatility, while Bitcoin is being treated as resilient above key support with room toward higher resistance. The strongest fresh signals in the available material are bearish gold and silver, bearish GBP/USD, and cautiously bullish BTC and GDX on reversal/support themes.
